title: cs-codex-turn can take Codex's newer-model offer for a screen it does not know, and fail the turn
foundBy: base-images runs 38198858723 and 39192761879, in the amd64 smoke of the candidate

evidence.verified: `go test ./internal/cli/ -run 'TestCodexTurnAnswersADialogOrSaysWhoMust|TestClaudeTurnAnswersADialogOrSaysWhoMust' -count=1` passes on b99d37f. Its new cases show a loading screen for two captures before the dialog. On the drivers before b99d37f they fail with `needs a person`, as the base-images runs did. The full `make ci` gate exited 0, with 14 of 14 agent replay cells passing on podman.

resolution: Both turn drivers capture the screen once per look and make every judgement about that one capture. A dialog that opens between two looks is seen whole on the next one. cs-claude-turn had the same shape and gets the same change.
details: Codex draws its main screen first and opens the `Meet GPT-6 Sol` offer once its model catalog loads. `detect_state` captured the pane once to look for a known dialog and again to look for an unknown one. When the offer appeared between the two captures, the second saw its `enter/esc confirm ·` footer and the driver failed the turn with `remote codex is on a screen that needs a person`, without answering. The codex-openai-shared replay failed this way in two weekly base-images runs. A loaded host widens the gap between captures, so it shows up in the smoke run, where four agent sandboxes share one runner. In a container limited to two CPUs with two busy loops, the race reproduced on the first launch.
